name: Admin Menu Levels
description: Enhances the menu admin UI with options to filter which menu items are shown.
project_description:
Admin Menu Levels is a lightweight JS library that provides two menu item filtering options on menu administration pages:

 
 A select list from which the user can choose the depth of the menu items to display (inclusive — meaning if "Two" is selected, menu items of depth 1 AND 2 will be shown) 
 A checkbox that will show/hide disabled menu items, respecting the choice made in the select list above 
 
 This helps with menus that can often be very long, with tens or hundreds of menu items in the list — the administration menu, for instance; it filters the list so you see only those items that you are interested in.
